messages.subject: Input Correlation Matrix
parts:
Dear all,

I have tried to input correlation matrix, but I have got this error message:

> lower <- '
+ 1,
+ -0.03, 1,
+ 0.39, 0.07, 1,
+ -0.05, -0.23, -0.13, 1,
+ -0.08, -0.16, -0.29, 0.34, 1'
> 
> stdv <- c(66.5,3.8,18.4,6.7,624.8)
> 
> 
> cor2cov(R=lower, sds=stdv)
Error in cor2cov(R = lower, sds = stdv) : 
  'V' is not a square numeric matrix

I wonder what is wrong with my data. In addition, can I also input the means of those five variables as well?

Thanks,
Chester Kam

messages.subject: Re: Input Correlation Matrix
parts:
Chester--
Use the lavaan::getCov() function to turn the string input into a square numberical matrix. The documentation is pretty clear.
